title: LessCode
summary: An AI-based IDE (Electron app) whose README focuses entirely on packaging a Windows installer, with no description of an SDV-related feature in the docs. However, a bundled script synthetic_data_generator.py fits SDV's CTGANSynthesizer on a dataframe using auto-detected metadata to produce synthetic rows, so SDV's sdv.single_table CTGANSynthesizer is run to generate synthetic data.
evidence: synthetic_data_generator.py:4-37: from sdv.single_table import CTGANSynthesizer; synthesizer = CTGANSynthesizer(metadata); synthesizer.fit(data)
needs: unclear how this synthetic data script relates to the IDE's core purpose; README does not mention it at all
